purpose: Owner rearm register for the book-level drawdown ladder (config/drawdown_control_contract.json). A FLAT_HALTED book stays flat until a dated entry here; from the first published mark on or after rearm_date the ladder restarts with the high-water mark reset to that mark. Entries are append-only and each is a recorded owner decision; scripts/book_drawdown_ladder.py reads this file every publish.

entry_shape.rearm_date: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC calendar date of the mark the restart takes effect on)
entry_shape.reason: why the owner judged the halt reviewed and the book fit to trade
